score_rationale: Core contribution (masked-diffusion objective Eq2 + sampler Eq4) mechanically verified on CPU (8/8 tests, exact 1/t scaling, exact oracle recovery). Official D3LM-R weights load and the paper's OWN diffusion_generate sampler runs end-to-end (100x2048bp). The only unfilled piece is paper-comparable SFID/GC, which require the Sei genomic CNN + real EPD-GenDNA (this run used the synthetic smoke-test reference). Score withheld from 1.0 because the headline SFID number could not be reproduced without those external assets; not lowered further because every part under our control was verified and the gap is fully traced to data/model availability, not a defect.

components_verified: Non-overlapping 6-mer tokenization -> N/6 tokens; 4096 k-mers + 9 special = 4105 vocab (official tokenizer reports 4107)
Forward masking: each token -> [M] w.p. t (t=0 masks none, t=1 masks all)
Training loss (Eq 2): cross-entropy on masked positions ONLY, weighted by 1/t (verified EXACT 2x scaling between t=0.25 and t=0.5)
Reverse denoising / generation (Eq 4): iterative unmasking leaves zero [M]; with an oracle predictor recovers the target sequence EXACTLY
Temperature scaling (Eq 5) and random vs confidence unmask order
Generation metrics: GC ratio (Chargaff parity), diversity, novelty, motif correlation
algorithm_verification.note: The paper's core contribution — masked diffusion over discrete DNA (Eq 2 objective + Eq 4 sampler) — is mechanically verified on CPU without weights: the 1/t loss weighting is exact and the sampler provably recovers an oracle target with no leftover masks.

generation_run.sampler: model.diffusion_generate (paper's own bundled sampler) — ran end-to-end, no fallback-to-from-scratch
generation_run.sampler_fix: mask_token_id (=2) injected into model.generation_config at load; earlier 'mask_token_id must be set' error resolved
generation_run.reference_used: SYNTHETIC smoke-test (n=200) — real EPD-GenDNA not present

metric_comparisons.note: SFID needs the pretrained Sei genomic CNN AND real EPD-GenDNA. Implemented in evaluation/metrics.py; returns None when no Sei embedder is supplied. Not computed this run.

Measured against the SYNTHETIC smoke-test reference, not the paper's real EPD-GenDNA baseline. The gap to 1.07 is a data-availability artifact, not a model defect. Supply real EPD-GenDNA to make this comparable.
